g.text: Nine metres and every one of them full of nothing. I sat in
the fourth row with the recorder on my knees and did not
move for a minute and ten.
I want to write down that I heard the hall breathe, so I am
writing it down and then I am writing down that a hall of
this size has a thermal cycle and the seats are horsehair
and it was breathing in the sense that a building breathes.
Practice wing next. Through the open stair hall off the
ground spine, then straight across the upper landing. Four
minutes if you know where you are going.
Radio check missed. I will get the next one.
